name: Radiant Logistics, Inc.
business_overview: Radiant Logistics, Inc., operates as a third-party logistics company, provides technology-enabled global transportation and value-added logistics services in the United States and Canada. The company offers domestic and international freight forwarding, and freight brokerage services, including air, ocean, truckload, less-than-truckload, and intermodal. It also provides logistics and supply chain services, such as materials management and distribution, customs house brokerage, and global trade management, as well as arranging shipments, and heavyweight and small package air services. The company serves the consumer goods, food and beverage, electronics, high-tech, aviation, automotive, military, government, manufacturing, and retail industries. The company was formerly known as Golf Two Inc. and changed its name to Radiant Logistics, Inc. in October 2005. Radiant Logistics, Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Renton, Washington.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Provides technology-enabled global transportation and value-added logistics services.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** Radiant Logistics is operating in a sharply divergent freight environment, yet the company is demonstrating resilience with steady demand across its global transportation and value-added services. The macro backdrop remains uneven, with mixed signals across shipping modes, but the firm’s technology-enabled, asset-light model is helping it navigate the choppy conditions. No single end-market or regional shift dominates the narrative; instead, the story is one of stable operations holding up amid a challenging and uncertain logistics cycle.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership is advancing the Navegate platform and progressing “Ray,” its first AI agent, aiming to embed operational excellence and long-term growth levers. The team is actively repurchasing shares, signaling confidence in the underlying business and a disciplined approach to capital allocation. A new institutional position from Rothschild Wealth lends external validation to the strategy, suggesting that the market is beginning to recognize management’s tech-forward direction and steady stewardship in a tough freight environment.
